work_unit: hybrid guest and JWT frontend flow

evidence.uncertainty: The backend credential contract was explicit, with one configuration-alignment issue found during integration.
evidence.scope: The work spans mode validation, the access-choice interface, browser-only session state, upload credentials, preview, review, question, and delete calls.
evidence.reasoning: The client must keep credentials in memory, distinguish Authorization from X-Document-Capability, and safely clear a JWT session on a 401 response.
evidence.verification: All three modes require linting, formatting, type checking, and production builds; the security contract also has focused backend coverage.

checks: Next.js type generation and TypeScript passed
Production webpack builds passed in capability, hybrid, and jwt modes
outcome.integration_note: The frontend example defaults to capability so it matches the credential-free root example; hybrid is enabled only after both frontend and backend settings are configured.
outcome.remaining: No guest-to-user document claim flow; guest data expires under the configured retention policy.
